product_overview: MediTriaje 2.0 es una plataforma web integral para triaje asistencial, urgencias, hospitalización, aseguramiento EPS, historia clínica inmutable y analítica operativa. Está orientada al contexto colombiano y soporta flujos clínicos y administrativos con control estricto de seguridad y roles.
core_goals: Permitir autenticación segura, MFA y recuperación de cuenta con sesiones protegidas.
Gestionar admisión de urgencias, pacientes NN, triaje presencial y cola priorizada.
Administrar camas, salas, traslados y egresos hospitalarios de forma concurrente y controlada.
Soportar carga masiva y consulta de afiliaciones EPS, citas médicas y restricciones por ausencias.
Proveer un centro de mando con KPIs, alertas operativas y seguimiento QR sin exponer datos clínicos.
Mantener una historia clínica y prescripción inmutables con dispensación farmacéutica auditada.

features.name: Autenticación y seguridad
features.description: Gestiona acceso seguro al sistema con credenciales robustas, MFA TOTP, recuperación por OTP y sesiones protegidas por cookies seguras.
user_flows: POST /api/auth/register with valid Colombian document data, consent, and strong password -> Receive 201 with account created -> POST /api/auth/login with valid credentials -> Receive 200 with HttpOnly session cookie -> POST /api/auth/mfa/verify with valid TOTP -> Receive 200 with fully authenticated session -> GET /api/profile with session cookie -> Receive 200 with user profile
POST /api/auth/register with invalid document type or missing consent -> Receive 400 with validation errors
POST /api/auth/login with invalid password multiple times -> Receive 423 or 429 with account lock or brute-force protection

POST /api/auth/recovery/request with unregistered email or identifier -> Receive 404 or 400 with generic recovery failure -> POST /api/auth/recovery/confirm with expired OTP -> Receive 400 with expired token error

features.name: Circuito asistencial de urgencias y triaje presencial
features.description: Permite admisión rápida sin cuenta previa, registro de pacientes NN, toma de signos vitales, clasificación de triaje I-V y gestión de la cola priorizada por sede.
user_flows: POST /api/emergency/admissions with patient data or anonymous intake -> Receive 201 with emergency admission record -> POST /api/emergency/triage with vital signs and Glasgow score -> Receive 200 with triage level assigned -> GET /api/emergency/queue?site={siteId} with nurse session -> Receive 200 with prioritized queue

POST /api/emergency/admissions without document for NN patient -> Receive 201 with provisional NN-XXXXXX identifier -> POST /api/emergency/triage with valid vitals -> Receive 200 with triage classification
POST /api/emergency/triage with missing vital signs or invalid values -> Receive 400 with validation errors
GET /api/emergency/queue without proper role -> Receive 403 forbidden for unauthorized access

features.name: Gestión hospitalaria, camas y traslados
features.description: Administra el censo de salas y camas, asignación atómica, movimientos intrahospitalarios, traslados a quirófano o recuperación y egreso médico.
user_flows: GET /api/hospital/beds with authenticated clinical staff -> Receive 200 with bed census and statuses -> POST /api/hospital/beds/{bedId}/assign with patient and encounter -> Receive 200 with atomic bed assignment -> POST /api/hospital/transfers with origin and destination locations -> Receive 201 with transfer recorded -> POST /api/hospital/discharges/{encounterId} -> Receive 200 with bed released and discharge finalized
POST /api/hospital/beds/{bedId}/assign when bed is already occupied -> Receive 409 conflict due to concurrent allocation
POST /api/hospital/transfers with invalid encounter or unavailable destination -> Receive 400 with validation error or 409 with occupancy conflict
POST /api/hospital/discharges/{encounterId} without clinical authorization -> Receive 403 forbidden

features.name: Aseguramiento EPS y citas médicas avanzadas
features.description: Gestiona catálogo de EPS, carga masiva de afiliados desde Excel, validación segura de archivos, confirmación de importación y reglas para agendas médicas.
user_flows: GET /api/eps/catalog with authenticated administrative user -> Receive 200 with active EPS catalog -> POST /api/eps/import/preview with XLSX file -> Receive 200 with paginated validation preview and metrics -> POST /api/eps/import/commit with mode ATOMIC_ALL -> Receive 201 with atomic import result
POST /api/eps/import/preview with Zip Bomb XLSX or malformed spreadsheet -> Receive 400 with file security validation error

POST /api/appointments with patient and scheduling data -> Receive 201 with appointment created when allowed -> POST /api/appointments when doctor absence or legal restriction applies -> Receive 409 or 400 with scheduling blocked
GET /api/eps/catalog without authentication -> Receive 401 unauthorized

features.name: Centro de mando, analítica y QR de seguimiento
features.description: Provee indicadores en tiempo real, alertas operativas auditablemente reconocidas y seguimiento por QR no clínico sin exponer PHI.
user_flows: GET /api/ops/dashboard with admin or operational role -> Receive 200 with KPIs in real time -> GET /api/ops/alerts -> Receive 200 with active operational alerts -> POST /api/ops/alerts/{alertId}/acknowledge with justification -> Receive 200 with auditable acknowledgment -> GET /api/ops/qr/{token} -> Receive 200 with non-clinical tracking payload
GET /api/ops/dashboard without operational permission -> Receive 403 forbidden
POST /api/ops/alerts/{alertId}/acknowledge with missing or weak justification -> Receive 400 with validation error
GET /api/ops/qr/{token} with expired or invalid token -> Receive 404 or 400 with token not valid

features.name: Historia clínica inmutable y farmacia
features.description: Administra atenciones cerradas e inmutables, enmiendas append-only, prescripción con snapshot, dispensación farmacéutica y acceso excepcional Break-Glass.
user_flows: POST /api/clinical/encounters with examination findings, diagnosis CIE-10 and closure data -> Receive 201 with encounter created -> POST /api/clinical/encounters/{encounterId}/close -> Receive 200 with immutable clinical encounter -> POST /api/pharmacy/prescriptions with medication snapshot -> Receive 201 with prescription issued -> POST /api/pharmacy/dispensations with prescription and batch data -> Receive 200 with delivery recorded
PUT /api/clinical/encounters/{encounterId} after closure -> Receive 403 or 409 because closed records are immutable
POST /api/clinical/encounters/{encounterId}/amendments with append-only note -> Receive 201 with audit trail preserved

POST /api/break-glass/request with justification shorter than 20 characters -> Receive 400 with rejection; POST /api/break-glass/request with valid justification -> Receive 201 with 24-hour emergency access granted

code_summary.description: Plataforma web integral de triaje asistencial, admision de urgencias, gestion hospitalaria y censo de camas, aseguramiento EPS, atencion clinica inmutable, dispensacion y centro de mando analitico (Valledupar, Colombia).

backend.security: Spring Security 6.5.11, Argon2id, JJWT 0.12.6, TOTP RFC 6238
backend.database: Oracle Autonomous Transaction Processing (ATP Cloud) / Oracle Free 23c
backend.migrations: Flyway 10 (21 migraciones versionadas V001 a V021)
backend.utilities: Apache POI OOXML 5.3.0, BouncyCastle 1.78.1, JavaMail Sender
backend.test_suite: JUnit 5, Mockito, MockMvc, AssertJ, Testcontainers (1002 pruebas pasando)

frontend.technologies: HTML5 semantico, CSS3 Vanilla (Design Tokens, WCAG 2.1 AA), JavaScript ES Modules

architecture_patterns: Clean Architecture por capas: Controller -> Service -> Repository
Contratos inmutables de API mediante Java Records (DTOs)
Inmutabilidad relacional asistencial mediante Triggers PL/SQL en Oracle
Control de acceso de minimo privilegio (RBAC) y aislamiento clinico estricto

roles_and_permissions.description: Autogestion de citas, triaje preliminar orientativo, consulta de recetas e historia personal, resumen QR de emergencia.
Agenda clinica del dia, apertura y cierre inmutable de atenciones, diagnostico CIE-10, prescripcion farmacologica, traslados, egreso y Break-Glass.
Admision de urgencias presenciales, asignacion de pacientes NN con identidades provisionales, triaje clinico I-V, cola priorizada por sede y asignacion de equipo.
Ventanilla de farmacia, busqueda de recetas, control de saldos acumulados, registro de lotes INVIMA y fechas de vencimiento.
Gestion de instituciones, sedes, especialidades, profesionales, turnos, importacion Excel de EPS, auditoria y mando operativo (aislamiento clinico 403 estricto).
